text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-i-t-i-a-t-e-d f-i-c-t-i-t-i-o-n a-l-g-o-r-i-t-h-m-s t-o m-i-m-i-c l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e f-o-r-e-s-t-y i-n-d-i-c-a-t-o-r-s, l-e-f-t s-c-r-i-p-t-e-d c-o-d-e b-a-s-e-d a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s, a-n-d b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n t-e-s-t-i-n-g.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-y-n-t-h-e-s-i-z-e-d s-a-t-e-l-l-i-t-e i-m-a-g-e-r-y u-s-i-n-g p-h-o-t-o g-r-a-p-h-i-c m-a-n-i-p-u-l-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-f-t r-a-w m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a f-o-o-t-p-r-i-n-t-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d c-r-o-s-s r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-i-n-g c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e s-o-u-r-c-e-s.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r g-e-n-e-r-a-t-e-d f-a-l-s-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-e-s b-y m-i-s-a-p-p-l-y-i-n-g a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-a-t-i-o-n m-a-t-r-i-x-e-s, l-e-f-t i-n-c-o-n-s-i-s-t-e-n-t s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s, a-n-d i-g-n-o-r-e-d i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t a-u-d-i-t p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-p-i-l-e-d m-i-s-l-e-a-d-i-n-g m-a-r-k-e-t-i-n-g n-a-r-r-a-t-i-v-e-s t-o t-a-r-g-e-t p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e-r s-c-r-u-t-i-n-y, l-e-f-t e-m-a-i-l t-h-r-e-a-d-s w-i-t-h a-g-g-r-a-v-a-t-e-d c-l-a-i-m-s, a-n-d o-v-e-r-l-o-o-k-e-d f-a-c-t c-h-e-c-k i-n-t-e-r-v-i-e-w-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r p-r-o-c-e-s-s-e-d p-a-y-m-e-n-t t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n-s f-o-r f-r-a-u-d-u-l-e-n-t u-n-i-t-s, l-e-f-t f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l r-e-c-o-r-d-s w-i-t-h l-a-g g-i-n-g s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d, a-n-d d-e-c-l-i-n-e-d f-r-e-q-u-e-n-c-y a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s o-f t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r s-t-a-t-u-s.
